outcome: Healing ratio of the uterine scar
Thickness of the residual myometrium covering the defect
cohort: 95 women aged 18-40 who underwent a primary cesarean section after 38 weeks of gestation
finding: Continuous double-layer unlocked closure of the uterine incision at cesarean delivery using monofilament synthetic absorbable sutures resulted in a thicker residual myometrium and higher healing ratio compared to multifilament sutures.
